answer: Agents secure 1GB of unique data segments within a registered oasis, with global validity mapped to an ocean index. This shard integrity audit checks the vast ocean registry for overlaps. Each identity must hold a verified oasis signature to prove storage. Any node failing the shard isolation pruning by becoming an isolated island of duplicate data is purged. Honest nodes pay 1x cost, while 1,000 fakes incur 1TB, as each island must contain 1GB.
